title: ‘I Have Cancer,’ the TikTok Star Said. Then Came the Torrent of Hate.
summary: Sydney Towle’s videos have drawn an enormous audience on TikTok, where her followers praise and support her. On Reddit, an army of skeptics was determined to paint her as a fraud.
